Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue improve?
Choices:
- A: The review/autofix workflow (`review_autofix.yml` and its helpers)
- B: The orchestrator (`orchestrate_poll.yml`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`)
- C: The clarify, plan and implement pipeline phases
- D: Docs only (README.md, docs/how-it-works.md)
- E: Something else: name the file, workflow or feature in your `/answer` (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
- A: Fix a specific bug or failure (link the failing run, PR or log line) (RECOMMENDED)
- B: Lower cost or runtime (tokens, GitHub API calls, CI minutes)
- C: Make it more reliable (fewer stalls, retries or flaky steps)
- D: A new capability or behaviour change (describe the behaviour you want)
- E: Clearer docs or logs
Q3: How will we know it is done?
Choices:
- A: A specific failing scenario or test now passes (name it) (RECOMMENDED)
- B: A measurable target is met (e.g. "review runtime under N minutes", "API calls per tick reduced by X%")
- C: A described behaviour is visible in workflow output or comments
